## Spear Dashing V1.1 — Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric

**Mod version: 1.1.** This JAR is compiled specifically for **Minecraft 26.3**. Install this version's JAR in your Fabric profile's `mods` folder.

### Must-download dependencies

- **Java 25+** and **Fabric Loader 0.19.5+** (startup tested with 0.20.1).
- **Fabric API**: [0.165.0+26.3](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/EQKgpeKu).
- **Fzzy Config — REQUIRED; the mod will not load without it**: [0.7.7+fix3+26.3](https://modrinth.com/mod/fzzy-config/version/YkOumqzV).
- **Fabric Language Kotlin — REQUIRED by Fzzy Config**: [1.14.2+kotlin.2.4.21](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin/version/SKW1BTL3).

### Controls and behavior

Place a Lunge-enchanted spear in the hotbar, then tap or hold **R**. The repeat/swap-back interval remains configurable from 1–5 ticks, subject to Minecraft's attack cooldown and server behavior.

### Port validation

Compiled against the exact Minecraft 26.3 game JAR using Java 25. An isolated Fabric client passed title-screen startup, Fzzy Config registration, key-binding registration, and application of the attack-invoker mixin. **In-world dash timing, multiplayer behavior, and unrelated-mod compatibility have not been tested.**

**JAR display name:** `Spear Dashing V1.1 MC26.3.jar`. GitHub normalizes spaces in stored asset filenames to dots.

**SHA-256:** `c9cfdeec7273925b4758e71200ac1afb03fe8bfed63ef2edeb735bd5c1f4cf77`

[Build instructions and dependency matrix](https://github.com/mmaarij123/Spear-Dashing/blob/0d0e465ff1de7186d05751443b0a84f5b89f5bc9/ports/README.md) · [Validation record](https://github.com/mmaarij123/Spear-Dashing/blob/0d0e465ff1de7186d05751443b0a84f5b89f5bc9/ports/VALIDATION.json)

releases.notes:
## Spear Dashing V1.1

Client-side spear swapping and dash controls for **Minecraft 1.21.11 / Fabric**.

### Download & install

Download **Spear Dashing V1.1.jar** from the assets below and place it in your Fabric profile's `mods` folder. Requires **Java 21+**, **Fabric API**, and **Fzzy Config 0.7.6** for Minecraft 1.21.11. Keep only one Spear Dashing JAR installed.

Put a Lunge-enchanted spear in your hotbar and press **R**. Hold the key to retry when the configured interval and attack cooldown allow.

### Included improvements

- Tick-based held-key detection and support for short taps.
- Configurable 1–5 tick retry and swap-back interval.
- Original-slot restoration during continuous use.
- Valid hotbar-slot searches and menu/world state handling.

The JAR is the previously published v1.1.0 binary, renamed for this release. Its compiled code and included licensing notices are unchanged. In-game timing and compatibility have not been verified.

**SHA-256:** `a997aec538a5dffd3f21473ec589051d035ee11791b708b700f5f789b32033e4`

See the repository's `LICENSE` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for licensing scope and preserved CC0 permissions.
